name: Creality CR-30 0.4 nozzle
machine_start_gcode:
; === Creality CR-30 3DPrintMill belt start ===
; Orca belt remap => machine axes: X=lateral  Y=nozzle gap above belt  Z=belt advance
G90 ; absolute XYZ
M82 ; absolute extrusion
G21 ; mm
M104 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] ; start heating hotend
M140 S[hot_plate_temp_initial_layer] ; start heating belt
G28 ; home X, Y(gantry), Z(belt)
G1 Y10 F600 ; back gantry ~10mm off the belt
M190 S[hot_plate_temp_initial_layer] ; wait belt temp
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] ; wait hotend temp
G92 E0
G1 Y0.30 F300 ; nozzle 0.30mm above belt (first-layer gap)
G1 X5 F3000 ; front edge of belt
G1 X165 E14 F1000 ; prime line 1 across the width
G1 Z0.4 F1000 ; advance belt 0.4mm
G1 X5 E28 F1000 ; prime line 2 back
G92 E0 Z0 ; zero E; belt origin - print starts here
machine_end_gcode:
; === Creality CR-30 belt end ===
M400 ; finish moves
G91 ; relative
G1 E-3 F1800 ; retract
G90 ; absolute
M104 S0 ; hotend off
M140 S0 ; belt heater off
M106 S0 ; fan off
G1 Y20 F600 ; lift gantry clear of the part
G1 Z600 F2000 ; advance belt to roll the part off (tune length)
G28 X ; home X ONLY - never G28 all (rewinds the belt)
M84 ; motors off
